scope: Official-source snapshot for a Telangana-local MBBS graduate comparing MCC, Telangana CQ, Rajasthan open-private and Telangana MQ. All dates/times are IST. Not a live notification service.

routes.name: MCC All India counselling
routes.headline: Round 1 result published; reporting 26 October–2 November
routes.summary: AIQ, central/institutional, deemed-university and participating DNB choices share MCC counselling. Each has its own eligibility and college fees.
critical: Float needs online joining AND institute document approval; willingness alone is not a confirmed admission.
An upgrade cancels the earlier seat automatically. You cannot choose between the two after the upgrade.
Round 2 onwards: non-joining or surrender risks forfeiture. Round 3 is a commitment; no resignation.

routes.name: Telangana Competent Authority Quota
routes.headline: Published registration window ended 23 October; web-option dates pending
routes.summary: For eligible Telangana-local candidates. Covers the state share of government seats and the Competent Authority share of private colleges; the registration notice also includes NIMS Hyderabad.
critical: Telangana-local status must meet the study/admission rules; domicile alone is not the complete test.
The free-exit date must come from a KNRUHS notice. MCC’s Round 1 rule does not create a Telangana exit window.
Discontinuing after free exit can trigger ₹50 lakh, stipend recovery under the bond and a three-year KNRUHS counselling bar.

routes.name: Rajasthan state counselling
routes.headline: Extended registration ended 24 October; security and choices close 29 October
routes.summary: A Telangana MBBS graduate is eligible in principle for the open 50% share of private seats. These are Rajasthan-administered seats, separate from MCC AIQ.
critical: Out-of-state candidates are treated as UR for state-category benefits and must meet UR qualification.
Private choices need ₹5 lakh security; higher security does not create eligibility for restricted state seats.
Report in person at the allotted-college desk at SMS Medical College, Jaipur, with originals and one-year tuition proof.

routes.name: Telangana Management Quota
routes.headline: Registration open: deadline 30 October, 4 PM IST
routes.summary: Separate registration from Telangana State/CQ. MQ1, MQ2/NRI and MQ3/institutional seats have distinct eligibility and university fees; the notification also includes Neelima/Anurag University.
critical: 85% of MQ1 is Telangana-local reserved and 15% open nationally. This split applies within MQ1, not all seats.
The ₹2 lakh clinical MQ1 university fee is separate from annual tuition and is not an MCC security deposit.
Discontinuation after second-phase counselling or later attracts ₹50 lakh and a three-year KNRUHS counselling bar under the prospectus.

rules.title: What MCC covers
rules.text: 50% AIQ contributed by participating state government colleges; 100% deemed and participating DNB seats; central-university/institute seats with their own internal eligibility. INI-CET is separate. “All MCC seats” is not the same as “50% state-government AIQ”.

rules.title: Central reservation, not Telangana’s roster
rules.text: AIQ: SC 15%, ST 7.5%, Central-list OBC-NCL 27%, EWS 10%; PwD 5% horizontal. State BC status alone is not Central OBC-NCL proof. No general women’s quota is listed in this AIQ reservation table. Deemed/minority/NRI and internal seats require their own rules.

rules.title: Float is online joining in 2026
rules.text: Submit Float willingness, upload clear mandatory documents and contact the allotted institute’s nodal officer. The institute verifies online. Resolve queries within the reporting window and retain the provisional seat-confirmation record. The bulletin calls for uploads within 2–3 days of final allotment so discrepancies can be resolved; the overall reporting deadline still controls.

rules.title: Freeze requires physical reporting
rules.text: Physically report with original documents and admission fees at the allotted institute. A final allotment letter or a Float click alone does not replace completion of joining.

rules.title: Keep the Round 1 seat while seeking an upgrade
rules.text: A properly joined Round 1 Float candidate may fill fresh Round 2 choices. If no upgrade occurs, the existing seat is retained. If you decide against Round 2 upgrading, FAQ 19 says not to fill fresh choices; verify the portal status. This retains a seat, not an indefinite right to free resignation.

rules.title: Upgrades are binding replacements
rules.text: On a Round 2 upgrade, the old Round 1 seat is automatically cancelled; it cannot be reclaimed. Obtain the online relieving record and complete joining of the new seat. Even a category upgrade at the same college needs fresh admission formalities. Non-joining of the upgraded seat forfeits security.

rules.title: Switching to a state seat
rules.text: The Round 1/2 scheme permits participation in state counselling. To take a state allotment, surrender the MCC seat formally: Float resignation online; Freeze resignation physically at the institute. Use the MCC-notified resignation period and save the accepted/generated record. A state allotment does not automatically resign MCC.

rules.title: Round 1 free exit has a time limit for joined candidates
rules.text: A Round 1 non-joiner can free exit. A joined candidate must use the formal resignation process within the period prescribed by MCC. The checked documents do not publish a separate exact resignation cut-off for every cross-counselling switch. Do not substitute the reporting deadline for an unannounced resignation deadline.

rules.title: Round 2: forfeiture; further entry needs fresh payment
rules.text: Non-joining or surrender of a Round 2 allotment forfeits security. The scheme permits eligible candidates who resigned/exited Round 2 to participate in Round 3 with fresh payment. Resignation still requires a permitted window.

rules.title: Round 3 and Stray are commitment rounds
rules.text: Non-joining a Round 3 seat forfeits security and eliminates further MCC participation. Joined Round 3 seats cannot be resigned. Stray allotment must be joined or security is forfeited. Eligibility for Stray also depends on prior allotments/joined status and Centre–State data sharing.

rules.title: Retained Float seats must physically join after Round 3
rules.text: After Round 3, physical reporting is mandatory for fresh/upgraded Round 3 allottees and Round 1/2 Float candidates who did not upgrade. Online Float cannot be continued indefinitely.

rules.title: AIQ plus deemed: only the higher MCC payment is prescribed
rules.text: FAQ 9 says candidates opting for both pay only ₹5,000 registration plus ₹2 lakh security. It does not prescribe ₹25,000 plus ₹2 lakh as two independently protected deposits. If both were collected, reconcile receipts with MCC/HLL; do not assume a government allotment limits forfeiture to ₹25,000.

rules.title: Refunds follow completion of counselling
rules.text: Eligible security refunds return to the original payment account after counselling, not immediately after each round. Keep that account/card active. Registration fees are non-refundable; tuition refunds and college bond liabilities are separate. The refund FAQ describes initiation within 15 days/working days and completion within 30 days of the relevant MCC notification/list.

rules.title: 2026 change explicitly identified by MCC
rules.text: Chapter 3 contrasts the 2025 physical process with the new 2026 Freeze/Float workflow. Use its online-joining and online Float-resignation instructions alongside the round rules; generic physical-reporting text elsewhere in the bulletin must be read in that context.

rules.title: MCC admission does not erase a college/state bond
rules.text: MCC directs candidates to confirm course fees, stipend, service obligations and bond amounts with the institution before choices. The state-government AIQ service policy, central institution, deemed college and DNB hospital can differ. Use the State bonds page for dated evidence, then confirm the actual 2026 contract.

rules.title: Local eligibility must be documented
rules.text: Local means at least four consecutive years of Telangana study ending in the relevant qualifying examination, subject to the stated exceptions. A Telangana UG-local entrant studying at the specified outside state-wide institution can qualify; a non-local-quota MBBS entrant in Telangana is not automatically local. Other-state candidates are ineligible. Your Telangana MBBS/local claim needs the prescribed study and admission records.

rules.title: Seat pools: government versus private
rules.text: The state-government share follows exclusion of contributed AIQ seats (normally 50% AIQ / 50% state under the MCC scheme). Private colleges have a 50% Competent Authority share alongside a separate 50% management share. Do not apply a private 50% split to government seats or double count women/service reservations as extra seats. Exact branch counts await the current KNRUHS matrix.

rules.title: Vertical and horizontal reservations
rules.text: SC 15% split as SC1 1%, SC2 9%, SC3 5%; ST 10%; BC 29% split A 7%, B 10%, C 1%, D 7%, E 4%. Women 33⅓% and PwD 5% are horizontal. Minority-college seats are for eligible Muslim-minority candidates. The displayed EWS qualifying score is not evidence of a separate 10% EWS seat allocation in this prospectus.

rules.title: In-service seats are a separate horizontal claim
rules.text: 20% in clinical broad specialties and 30% in pre/para-clinical broad specialties are reserved horizontally for eligible in-service candidates under the cited service rules. These are not extra seats, and an ordinary fresh applicant cannot claim them.

rules.title: Qualification, internship and existing PG study
rules.text: NEET-PG 2026 qualification, completed internship by 30 September 2026 and permanent Telangana State Medical Council registration are required. The prospectus excludes candidates already studying PG degree/diploma/DNB; get KNRUHS clarification before assuming an existing PG enrolment or cross-counselling switch is eligible. A same-cycle MCC option does not override state conditions.

rules.title: Separate application and web options
rules.text: Complete CQ registration, payment and certificate uploads; print the application. Provisional/final merit and web-option schedules are published separately. A qualified list or registration is not an allotment. At admission submit originals, application printout and self-attested copies at the allotted college.

rules.title: University fee and tuition are separate
rules.text: Pay ₹35,000 university fee to download the allotment letter. Tuition is as notified by Telangana and varies by institution/course category. The registration/processing fee is non-refundable. The reviewed prospectus does not establish a separate universally refundable security deposit or the refund treatment of every university-fee situation.

rules.title: Do not import MCC’s free-exit rules
rules.text: The CQ prospectus refers to the last date for Free Exit but does not provide that date in the reviewed registration documents. Await the phase-specific KNRUHS notice for reporting, sliding, resignation and exit deadlines. Leaving after the stated free-exit limit attracts the prospectus discontinuation terms.

rules.title: Course discontinuation: ₹50 lakh, with additional conditions
rules.text: The admission bond states ₹50 lakh on default in completing training and refund of stipend/salary received. Discontinuation after free exit also carries a three-year KNRUHS PG counselling debarment. These are not small registration-deposit penalties; read the signed bond and applicable exit notice.

rules.title: One-year service after completion
rules.text: Non-service postgraduates must serve the Government of Telangana for one year if required under the government orders. The admission service bond is ₹20 lakh for a PG degree and ₹10 lakh for a diploma. This is separate from the ₹50 lakh course-completion bond.

rules.title: AP domicile is not an automatic state-quota entitlement
rules.text: The 2026 prospectus uses G.O.148 dated 28 October 2024 and the local-candidate rules. Do not carry forward an old shared AP/Telangana non-local entitlement. The state-wide-institution exception and non-local UG exclusion must be read exactly. SC subgrouping cites an April 2025 order: neither provision should be advertised as newly introduced in 2026 without the amendment history.

rules.title: Private management share and the correct denominators
rules.text: Management is 50% of each private college’s specialty seats: MQ1 is 25%, MQ2/NRI 15%, MQ3/institutional 10% of the TOTAL seats. Within MQ1 only, 85% is Telangana-local reserved and 15% nationally open. As an illustration on 100 total seats, these are 21.25 local MQ1 + 3.75 open MQ1 + 15 MQ2 + 10 MQ3, with actual seats rounded by the official roster/matrix.

rules.title: Local reservation is different from caste reservation
rules.text: MQ has no SC/ST/BC community reservation and no other general reservations listed; reserved-category cut-offs affect exam qualification only. The explicit MQ1 local/open split still applies. Minority-college seats go to eligible Muslim-minority candidates; non-minority conversion is described only for the last phase if eligible minority candidates are unavailable.

rules.title: MQ1, MQ2 and MQ3 are not interchangeable
rules.text: MQ1 includes national applicants subject to the 85/15 local split. MQ2 requires the specified NRI/OCI/NRI-sponsorship proof. MQ3 requires a principal’s sponsorship and the defined institutional connection: own MBBS graduate, employee or employee’s son/daughter. Paying a higher fee alone does not establish MQ2/MQ3 eligibility.

rules.title: Medical registration and internship
rules.text: Recognised MBBS, NEET-PG 2026 qualification, internship completed by 30 September 2026 and permanent Telangana State Medical Council registration are required. Upload documents at application; do not rely on a later opportunity to cure missing eligibility.

rules.title: ₹15,000 application; university fee on allotment
rules.text: Registration/processing is ₹15,000 plus transaction charges, non-refundable. Clinical university fees: MQ1 ₹2 lakh; MQ2/MQ3 ₹3 lakh. Non-clinical: MQ1 ₹75,000; MQ2/MQ3 ₹1 lakh. These university fees are paid to download the allotment order, separate from annual tuition, and are not described as MCC-style refundable security deposits.

rules.title: ₹23 lakh is not a verified universal 2026 tuition
rules.text: The 2026 prospectus says tuition is government-notified. The checked G.O.107 explicitly covers the 2023–2026 block and shows college/category variation, including ₹23 lakh and ₹24 lakh clinical Cat-B examples. Do not silently apply that expired block to 2026–27 or apply clinical rates to Pathology/Biochemistry. Confirm the current order and college invoice before choices.
rules.status: Historical fee evidence; current tuition pending

rules.title: MQ needs its own registration
rules.text: CQ registration does not register you for MQ. Apply and upload at pvttspgmed.tsche.in by 30 October, 4 PM IST. The notification includes KNRUHS private colleges and Neelima Institute affiliated to Anurag University. Current MQ merit, options, allotment and reporting dates are to be notified separately.

rules.title: ₹50 lakh discontinuation liability
rules.text: The admission completion bond is ₹50 lakh. The prospectus explicitly imposes ₹50 lakh plus a three-year KNRUHS counselling bar for discontinuation after the second phase of counselling or later. Do not infer a first-phase no-cost resignation deadline: obtain the phase notice and institution refund terms before a switch.

rules.title: One-year senior residency at the same institution
rules.text: The prospectus requires the admitted candidate to undertake one year as Senior Resident at the institution where the PG course was pursued after successful completion. This differs from CQ government-service wording. Confirm the actual agreement, appointment/pay and any institutional applicability before admission.

rules.title: Local MQ1 split is now explicit in the current prospectus
rules.text: The 2026 document cites G.O.200 and G.O.201 dated 3 November 2025 for the 85%-local/15%-open split within MQ1, using G.O.148 for local status. This is a current rule with a 2025 order date, not proof that local preference began only in 2026. Exact 2026 counts await the phase matrix.

rules.title: Your main route is open private seats
rules.text: 50% of total private-college seats are open to eligible NEET-PG candidates with an NMC-recognised MBBS from anywhere. The other private half and the state-government share have Rajasthan MBBS / specified government-service eligibility through Round 3. Telangana domicile alone does not qualify for those restricted seats.

rules.title: Government AIQ and Rajasthan private AI are different
rules.text: 50% of government/government-society/RUHS CMS seats go through MCC AIQ; remaining state seats and all private seats go through the Rajasthan Board. A private seat labelled “AI nature” is Rajasthan counselling, not an MCC allotment. Management labels in government-society institutions do not waive state eligibility.

rules.title: Out-of-state applicants are UR for state-category benefits
rules.text: Rajasthan’s SC/ST/OBC-NCL/MBC-NCL/EWS benefits are for eligible bonafide Rajasthan candidates. Other-state category candidates are considered UR and must qualify as UR. The booklet states at least 25% women within each category and 5% horizontal PwD; do not assume a Telangana caste certificate or every state reservation benefit transfers to the open-private route.

rules.title: Internship and council registration
rules.text: Internship must finish by 30 September 2026. Valid NMC/MCI/state council registration is required; if registered with another state initially, submit Rajasthan Medical Council registration within one month after joining. State-process Post-MBBS DNB/diploma seats are only for regular Rajasthan government in-service candidates, separate from MCC DNB.

rules.title: Private choices need one ₹5 lakh security payment
rules.text: Application is ₹4,000 plus charges for your out-of-state route. Private-college choices require ₹5 lakh security in one transaction. The ₹1 lakh government and ₹2 lakh government-society/RUHS management tiers do not need to be added to ₹5 lakh; depositing the higher tier permits lower-tier choices only where otherwise eligible.

rules.title: Security is adjustable against tuition after joining
rules.text: On joining, Rajasthan security is adjusted against tuition. If neither forfeited nor adjusted, it is refunded to the original payment account after counselling. Reconcile the allotment-letter demand and Board payment instructions so adjustment is not confused with a second tuition charge. Registration is non-refundable.

rules.title: Report at SMS Jaipur, with one-year tuition
rules.text: Report in person at the allotted-college desk, Academic Block, SMS Medical College, Jaipur, within the schedule. Pay the complete first-year tuition via NEFT/RTGS to the Board account printed on the allotment letter; bring proof, originals, copies and bonds. Downloading the allotment is not joining. The booklet requires accepted resignation/relieving from another current institution.

rules.title: Round 1 free exit; retained seats acquire later-round obligations
rules.text: Non-joining Round 1 does not forfeit security. A joined Round 1 candidate who is not upgraded in Round 2 (or does not participate) may resign without forfeiture within two days of the Round 2 result. After that, the retained seat is treated under Round 2 rules. Formal portal-generated resignation is necessary; offline resignation is not accepted.

rules.title: Round 2 resignation is restricted, not an automatic paid exit
rules.text: Non-joining a fresh/upgraded Round 2 seat forfeits security and further participation requires re-registration and fresh security. Joined Round 2/retained seats generally cannot be resigned except in specifically notified windows (including identified AIQ switches). Do not assume losing ₹5 lakh alone buys permission to leave a joined course.

rules.title: Round 3 and Stray restrictions
rules.text: Round 3 non-joining forfeits security and excludes Stray. Joined/retained Round 3 seats cannot be resigned. Stray non-joining forfeits security and bars further state rounds, with the participation bond terms also relevant. The local-eligibility restriction is relaxed for vacancies after Round 3, but prior allotment/joined-status exclusions remain.

rules.title: Fresh choices and irreversible upgrades
rules.text: Fresh choices are mandatory for Round 2 and Round 3 upgrading. An upgraded seat automatically vacates the earlier seat; originals transfer to the upgraded institution rather than being handed to the candidate. Being content with the old seat after the upgrade does not restore it.

rules.title: Private course-exit surety is separate from security
rules.text: A private-college surety can require remaining-course fees if the course is left mid-way. The booklet prohibits advance fees, post-dated cheques or bank guarantees for the remaining two years. Government non-service seats have separate service/surety bonds. A refundable deposit is not the maximum possible liability.

rules.title: Registration extension overrides only the original registration dates
rules.text: The live notice published 22 October extended Part 1 to 24 October, 4 PM IST and Part 2 to 24 October, 8 PM IST; a 24 October reminder reiterated completion. No new security/choice dates were found in the checked feed. Keep the original Round 1 schedule for those other events, subject to future amendments.

scenarios.title: Keep my MCC Round 1 Float seat and try to upgrade
scenarios.risk: Commit only to upgrades you would actually join
steps: Check that the institute has approved your uploaded documents and your portal shows provisional joining/Float, not merely willingness submitted.
Fill and lock fresh Round 2 choices within the published window. Put only acceptable replacements above the existing option; an allotment cannot be compared against the old seat afterwards.
If upgraded, obtain the online relieving letter and complete the new joining process. The old seat is cancelled automatically.
If not upgraded, the joined earlier seat is retained. Watch later-round resignation rules and mandatory physical reporting after Round 3.
scenarios.money: Proper upgrading itself does not forfeit security. Non-joining the upgraded Round 2/3 seat does. College transfer/refund charges remain separate.
scenarios.gap: No universal college-tuition exemption is established for Float. Confirm institute-specific payment instructions.

scenarios.title: Keep my MCC seat and stop seeking upgrades
scenarios.risk: Retaining a seat is different from resigning it
steps: FAQ 19 says a joined Round 1 candidate who changes their mind about Round 2 upgrading need not fill fresh Round 2 choices; the old seat will be retained.
Verify your retained seat and willingness status with the portal/nodal officer. If choosing Freeze, follow the required physical-reporting and fee formalities.
Do not later assume Round 1 free exit remains available indefinitely. Obtain the applicable resignation notice before any cross-counselling change.
scenarios.money: Keeping the seat does not itself forfeit security. College tuition/bond obligations still apply.
scenarios.gap: The exact process/timing for changing an existing Float selection to Freeze should be confirmed with the institute and current portal guide.

scenarios.title: Take a Rajasthan private seat instead of my MCC seat
scenarios.risk: Coordinate two authorities; avoid double joining
steps: Confirm your Rajasthan Part 1 and Part 2 were completed by the extended 24 October deadlines. The checked registration window is now closed.
For private choices, pay ₹5 lakh security by 29 October, 5 PM IST and save choices by 11:45 PM. Confirm open-private eligibility and AI/Management seat nature.
Rajasthan’s scheduled R1 allotment is 2 November; reporting is 3–6 November. This sits after MCC R1 reporting ends on 2 November, so do not assume the dates create a valid MCC resignation window.

Before committing to the state seat, check the live MCC resignation window and coordinate the accepted online Float resignation/relieving record and originals. Rajasthan requires accepted resignation at joining.
Pay one-year tuition per allotment-letter instructions, reconcile security adjustment and report at SMS Jaipur in person with originals and bonds.
scenarios.money: A permitted MCC R1 resignation is the free-exit route; if you have upgraded to MCC R2, forfeiture rules apply. Rajasthan deposit/tuition and its private-course surety are independent obligations.
scenarios.gap: The exact MCC resignation window for this dated switch has not been established. Do not resign or join a second course based solely on this planned calendar overlap.

scenarios.title: Take Telangana State / CQ instead
scenarios.risk: Check both MCC resignation and KNRUHS phase rules
steps: Confirm you submitted the separate CQ application and local/study documents within the notified window (published deadline 23 October, 4 PM IST).
Wait for the official KNRUHS merit, web-option and reporting notice. National coordination dates alone do not open state web options.
If allotted a preferred eligible CQ seat, coordinate a valid MCC resignation and accepted relieving record; verify any already-studying PG condition with KNRUHS.
Pay the ₹35,000 university fee to download the order and the applicable college tuition; report with originals and execute the course/service bonds as required.
scenarios.money: MCC security treatment depends on your MCC round at resignation. CQ has separate fees and potentially ₹50 lakh discontinuation plus service-bond obligations after the applicable triggers.
scenarios.gap: KNRUHS options/reporting/free-exit dates and the applicable new tuition order remain to be confirmed.

scenarios.title: Take Telangana Management / MQ instead
scenarios.risk: Apply separately now; confirm the complete admission cost
steps: Complete the separate MQ application by 30 October, 4 PM IST. Upload MBBS, internship, TS Medical Council and any MQ2/MQ3 eligibility proof.
As Telangana-local, confirm local documents for the 85% reserved share within MQ1. Do not assume eligibility for MQ2/NRI or MQ3 simply from willingness to pay.
Obtain the current 2026–27 college/course/category tuition order and written compulsory-charge/refund details before choices. Old ₹23 lakh examples are not current universal quotes.
Coordinate an MCC resignation in its permitted window before joining a replacement course. Then complete KNRUHS university-fee, original-document and college reporting requirements.
scenarios.money: ₹15,000 application; clinical MQ1 university fee ₹2 lakh, or MQ2/MQ3 ₹3 lakh, plus tuition and other applicable costs. These do not replace MCC security or protect it from forfeiture.
scenarios.gap: MQ phase options/reporting/exit dates and current tuition need official confirmation; late discontinuation is a much larger liability than an application fee.

scenarios.title: Leave MCC without taking another seat yet
scenarios.risk: Giving up a seat gives up its fallback protection
steps: Check the current MCC resignation notice and ensure the joined seat is still within an allowed exit window.
For Float, submit the online surrender/resignation and save the portal-generated/accepted record; resolve any institute confirmation needed.
After resignation, you have no claim to that seat. Eligibility and fresh-payment requirements for later rounds depend on the round in which you exited.
Do not treat ignoring messages, not attending, or letting a reporting deadline expire as a valid resignation of a joined seat.
scenarios.money: R1 free exit applies under its permitted rules. R2 surrender/non-joining forfeits security; joined R3 resignation is not allowed. Application fees and college charges are separate.
scenarios.gap: No exact joined-R1 resignation cut-off was established in the checked notices. Confirm it before acting.

checklist: Save the final allotment letter, completed joining/verification record and Float/Freeze willingness proof.
Check the institute portal for document queries; keep the nodal-officer contact and a dated response record.
Keep NEET admit/score cards, MBBS marks/degree, internship completion, DOB/ID, council registration and applicable current category/local certificates ready.
Maintain separate payment receipts for each authority: application, security, university fee, tuition, hostel/caution.
Before any switch, confirm the old authority’s resignation window, the new authority’s joining deadline and original-document release.
Save an accepted portal-generated resignation/relieving record; a state allotment is not an automatic MCC withdrawal.
Check exact course, campus, qualification, category and seat nature before choice locking; upgrading cancels the previous seat.
Read both course-discontinuation and post-course-service bonds before signing; security forfeiture is not a liability cap.
Keep the original payment account active for refunds; store receipts privately, never in a public GitHub repository.
Recheck live official notices before each payment, choice-locking, reporting or resignation action.
